name: Thaumaturgy (Path of the Focused Mind) — Advanced — Perfect Clarity

system.description: By spending a temporary Willpower Trait, the thaumaturge achieves a moment of pure thought, becoming temporarily immune to frenzy and Rotschreck (even through supernatural means), gaining a two-Trait bonus in any challenge, and severing any attempt by others (including Presence or Dominate) to influence or control her. This power lasts for one combat scene or 10 minutes.
